findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/quorum-submit.ts:230-255 [HIGH] The claimed exact causal envelope is validated only by event type + verdictId. A concurrent mutation can keep those two fields while changing hostId/sessionId/keyId/decision/materialDigest/storyFilesHash/validationDigest/promptDigest; assertExactQuorumAppend then accepts and the immutable transaction commits the forged L4 host_verdict row. This contradicts CHK-002 happy:1/adversarial:1 and the new process-fact atomic-persistence claim. Compare every persisted row against the full canonical event derived from the returned verdict/bindings (or bind exact generated bytes/digests), and add a focused mutation test that preserves verdictId while altering a gate-consumed field and proves refusal/rollback. The same exact-byte ownership rule should govern ignored verdict-file rollback: lines 321-326 delete a concurrently changed file solely because verdictId still matches, so foreign bytes can be lost.
findings.resolvedReason: rootCause: exact append validation compared only type and verdictId, while verdict-file rollback also trusted verdictId instead of frozen bytes. repro: mutate decision on the sixth process event and mutate the sixth ignored JSON while retaining verdictId. reproTest: quorum-submit-smoke checks same-verdictId gate-field mutation refusal and concurrent JSON preservation. evidence: build PASS; quorum-submit-smoke PASS 27/27; commit 8d7b031bfa freezes full canonical event rows and JSON bytes, refuses mismatches, and preserves changed foreign bytes.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/quorum-submit-smoke.ts:106-134,357-399 — HIGH coverage gap: the 27-intent evidence marks CHK-001 happy:0/happy:1/edge:0/adversarial:0/adversarial:2 and CHK-003 happy:0/adversarial:0 as covered by this smoke, but the smoke creates a synthetic temp repository with synthetic PASS evidence and invokes registry.get("quorum_submit") directly; it never invokes the worktree-local CLI, never runs the validation persistence path, never demonstrates the historical validation refusal/no-false-PASS boundary, and never proves the harness rejects a direct-handler-only shortcut. The only post-quorum check at lines 390-399 calls captureLifecycleMetadataTransaction and expects success after GREEN. The sole pre-dirty case at lines 579-592 is an untracked user file, not the separately required pre-dirty process-events plus staged/source/lifecycle cases. Thus several MUST intents are contradicted or only narratively attested while checklist evidence claims executable coverage. Add a bounded production-entry integration that runs node bin/lattice.js quorum_submit in a real fixture/worktree and exercises the validation persistence refusal on the RED implementation (or bind a concrete immutable historical receipt), plus the explicitly required pre-dirty categories; keep the existing fast handler matrix for fault injection.
findings.resolvedReason: rootCause: the prior smoke used a direct registry handler in a synthetic repo and never crossed the worktree-local CLI or validation canonical persistence boundary; the CLI also appended a post-handler codex_cli row that re-dirtied process-events. repro: node bin/lattice.js quorum_submit in the bounded fixture left a codex_cli delta, and validate on the historical six-row dirty baseline executed once then returned infra_failure. reproTest: quorum-submit-smoke production-entry cases cover clean CLI quorum, process-events/staged-source/lifecycle pre-dirt, and historical RED validation no-false-PASS. evidence: smoke PASS 27/27; validation payload status=fail allPass=false failureKind=infra_failure disposition=executed commandExecutions=1; original FAIL evidence and bytes preserved; commit 8d7b031bfa.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/quorum-submit.ts:398-410 and packages/main/src/tasks/quorum-submit-smoke.ts:489-512 — HIGH: same-material duplicate refusal trusts listVerdicts(), whose .lattice/autopilot-verdicts JSON files are gitignored/non-durable, instead of the canonical committed host_verdict events. Deleting that ignored directory after a successful quorum makes the same-material retry emit and commit another six rows, violating the explicit idempotency contract. The current smoke only tests while ignored JSON remains. Derive duplicate detection from committed process-events (exact runId/material binding), and add a regression that removes/loses the cache before retry.

packages/main/src/handlers/quorum-submit.ts:284-314 and packages/main/src/tasks/quorum-submit-smoke.ts:595-612 — HIGH: rollback claims to preserve malformed/foreign concurrent bytes verbatim but decodes the entire suffix as UTF-8, drops blank lines, and rejoins with a synthesized trailing newline. A concurrent non-UTF8 byte, blank line, or unterminated append is therefore rewritten/corrupted during rollback. The smoke covers only normalized JSON plus newline and asserts marker presence, not byte equality. Remove owned rows by exact byte spans while copying every other byte unchanged, and assert Buffer equality for malformed/non-UTF8 and unterminated foreign suffixes.
